Main's old hard-coded `Goldkelch` evaluator is historical execution source, not the current human Authority identity. #484 binds `@ingolf-lohmann` in CODEOWNERS and rejects author self-approval and automated approval; its technical disposition workflow never supplies independent APPROVE.

The current heads of #455, #457 and #447 have native `failure: CODE_OWNER_RULE_NOT_ENFORCED` from Trusted Main run [37245701417](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/37245701417). This issue records an administrative capability HOLD; it does not certify a policy repair, native approval, merge or publication.

The executing connection exposes no repository-administration writer or workflow-dispatch operation. Branch-protection GET returns `403 Resource not accessible by integration`. Repository metadata `admin=true` does not establish an Administration-capable token.

The smallest one-time native write for the freshly observed empty inventory is `POST /repos/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/rulesets` with a repository-scoped credential carrying `Administration: write`. Reuse the existing canonical ruleset projection, active on `refs/heads/main`, with no bypass actors and all four review predicates. Preserve the additional canonical status-check, thread-resolution, deletion and non-fast-forward requirements. Re-read first; if rules now exist, do not create a duplicate or overwrite stronger policy.

No administrative write, dispatch or rerun was attempted. Resume only after a verified writer is available or an actual administrative effect can be freshly read back. After activation, read the actual returned ruleset id and effective branch rules, then run the existing Trusted Main required-review gate and read matching statuses on freshly reobserved heads for #455, #457 and #447. With their currently empty native reviews, successful rule repair is expected to expose `pending: CODE_OWNER_REVIEW_MISSING`; this is a model-derived expectation, not observed post-change success.
